connector.name: Capital.com MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: Unofficial community MCP for the Capital.com Open API. Guarded two-phase trades; demo-first.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package capitalcom-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the simontarara62 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: CAP_ENV_FILE
env.description: Path to a .env file holding credentials (alternative to inline secrets).

env.name: CAP_API_KEY
env.description: Capital.com API key (use a DEMO key first).

env.name: CAP_ALLOW_TRADING
env.description: Set true to enable order execution (off by default).

env.name: CAP_ALLOWED_EPICS
env.description: Comma-separated EPIC allowlist for trading, or ALL.
